请求体 `{\"authUsers\": [], \"ssoDomain\":: Request body `{"authUsers": [], "ssoDomain": "", "selfServicePassword": false, "oidc": {}, "sites": [{"listener": "l1", "site": "s1", "sharedUsers": true}]}`. Fields mean the same as in the global settings; only these are changed and the other global settings stay as they are; the masked placeholder keeps the existing password or secret. `sites` lists only the sites to change: enabling shared users on a site without authentication also turns on web auth; a site that authenticates only with shared users cannot be cleared here (it would no longer require signing in), and sites using forward auth cannot be enabled. If anything fails validation, nothing is saved.
请求体 `{\"id\": \"\u003c旧版本 ID\u003e\"}`。当: Request body `{"id": "<previous version ID>"}`. The current version is saved as a previous version so you can switch back; processes using the program are restarted afterwards.
请求体 `{\"language\": \"zh-CN\"}`。管理界面在管理员: Request body `{"language": "zh-CN"}`. Called by the admin console when the language is switched while signed in as the administrator; when the server language is "Follow system" and the environment sets no language, logs and notifications use this language. Admin login sessions only.
请求体 `{\"version\": \"\", \"proxy\": \"\": Request body `{"version": "", "proxy": ""}`: an empty `version` installs the latest stable release (nothing is downloaded when it is already installed, `stage` is uptodate), otherwise the given version; `proxy` is the download proxy (http, https or socks5), saved for next time, and an empty value uses the global `updateProxy` setting. The download is verified against its SHA-256 and installed into bin under the config directory, the existing version moves to the previous versions, and processes using the program are restarted. Returns immediately; query the progress with `GET /api/{module}/install`.
请求体 `{\"version\": 3, \"rules\": [{\"hos: Request body `{"version": 3, "rules": [{"hostname": "app.example.com", "path": "", "service": "http://localhost:8080", "originRequest": {}}], "catchAll": "http_status:404", "syncDns": true}`. Returns 409 when `version` differs from the current version on Cloudflare. Only ingress is replaced; other fields of the remote config and the origin settings of the catch-all rule stay as they are, and running cloudflared picks up the change automatically. With `syncDns` true, a proxied CNAME record pointing to `<tunnel ID>.cfargotunnel.com` is created for each hostname (requires DNS edit permission); existing records are left untouched. Results are in `dns`: `created`, `unchanged`, `conflict` (`existing` holds the existing record) or `failed` (`error` holds the reason).

Sites are merged into an existing listener on the same port or into a new listener, and existing domains are skipped; when `enable` is false the import is left disabled.
